chapter_title_en: A Bold Entrance into the Prince's Residence
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch147: A Beauty in the North – Political Tensions
chapter_meta_description: Prince Sun Miao summons Xiao Chen to his banquet, aiming to use him as a spectacle. Xiao Chen refuses, beats the prince's soldiers, and crashes the hall, sitting boldly among the nobles.
og_title: World of Immortality – A Beauty in the North: Xiao Chen's Defiance
og_description: Xiao Chen confronts Prince Sun Miao and the noble factions of Heavenly Emperor City in a tense political standoff. Refusing to be a puppet, he makes a defiant entrance.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Defies the Prince in Heavenly Emperor City
twitter_description: Political intrigue and defiance in the World of Immortality. Xiao Chen enters the prince's hall uninvited and sits with the noble heirs.
